intro: The Tecno Gaming Chair is designed as an all-around command seat for gaming, study, and work-from-home setups. It combines immersive comfort with precise support, so you can focus longer with less fatigue.

features.title: Breathable knitted comfort
features.text: The main surfaces of Techno use soft knitted fabric that feels gentle against the skin while allowing heat and moisture to dissipate. Mesh panels and synthetic leather at the rear side of the frame add extra airflow while adding a classic touch to the seating.

features.title: Recline and relax
features.text: A smooth reclining mechanism lets you lean back from an upright 90 degrees to a relaxed 108 degrees, helping you shift posture, ease back tension, and find your personal comfort zone between focus and downtime.

features.title: Customisable lumbar support
features.text: An adjustable lumbar element lets you fine-tune lower-back support, so the chair adapts to your spine instead of the other way around. This targeted reinforcement helps reduce slouching and discomfort during extended use.

features.title: Soft curves with an elevated presence
features.text: A smooth gas lift allows easy seat-height changes within a 411–510 mm range, so you can align your eyes with the screen and your arms with the desk at the right ergonomic level.

features.title: Bucket seat for locked-in comfort
features.text: The bucket-style seat cradles your hips and thighs, keeping you centred even during intense gameplay while still allowing natural movement. Its contouring helps distribute pressure more evenly across the seat, reducing numbness and encouraging better posture over time.

features.title: High backrest that envelops you
features.text: A tall backrest supports the full length of your spine and shoulders, creating a cocooned feel that enhances immersion. The generous height also pairs well with head and neck support, so leaning back between rounds feels restful rather than straining.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
